description: Three Halcyon containers are sitting in the Yards with numbers on their seals that ought to match a list. Check them, and say nothing if they don't.
name: Seal Check

objectives.desc: Check the seal numbers at Bonded Store 7.
emotes: {who} reads seal numbers off a container door and ticks them against a Halcyon list.

objectives.desc: Check the rest at the Kessler Container Yard.
emotes: {who} finds a seal number that isn't on the list, looks at it for a while, and ticks it anyway.
